**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

Section 9.4, read with Section 29.4, delivers our preferred position: a 30-day without-cause termination right covering the Agreement and any Order Form, with only accrued Fees owed and a mandatory refund of prepaid Fees (echoed in Section 10.2). Vendor has no convenience right anywhere — Sections 9.1–9.3 limit it to material breach and insolvency, and Section 24.4 bars termination on our change of control. No action required for T4C.
